ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in rectangle $ABCD$, $E$ is a point on the extension of $BC$. Connect $AC$, $DE$, and let $BE=AC$. If $\angle ACB = 40^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle E$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since quadrilateral ABCD is a rectangle,\\
it follows that AC=BD, and AC, BD bisect each other,\\
therefore BO=CO,\\
thus $\angle$DBE=$\angle$ACB=40$^\circ$.\\
Since BE=AC,\\
it follows that BD=BE,\\
thus $\angle$E=$ \frac{180^\circ−\angle DBE}{2}=\frac{180^\circ−40^\circ}{2}=\boxed{70^\circ}$.
